basis: Manual reviewer judgment (not an automated test) comparing BaseBook guard/focus with frozen legacy taskRules for the 31 tasks whose rules do not literally contain book text. Legacy contracts must stay byte-equivalent, so no edit was made.

gap_book_guard_not_in_task_rules.2: Do not narrate every bar mechanically
gap_book_guard_not_in_task_rules.9: Do not reduce either view to a strawman
gap_book_guard_not_in_task_rules.18: Do not require cue bullets in exact order
gap_book_guard_not_in_task_rules.21: Keep short enough for repeated practice
gap_book_guard_not_in_task_rules.50: Mentioning rule label is not usage
gap_book_guard_not_in_task_rules.62: If correct, give harder context rather than invented correction

caveat: Global/domain rules in composeAssessmentPrompt may cover some of these (e.g. no pronunciation without acoustic evidence); not exhaustively traced. A gap means the task-specific guard is absent from the task rules, not that behavior is proven wrong.
remedy_options: OWNER DECISION: add a versioned, additive prompt supplement (new contract version, legacy v1 bytes untouched) - changes provenance hashes of future evaluations
